sysevent_email_template.message_html:
<html>
<body style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6;">
  <p>Dear ${requested_for.name}，</p>
  
  <p>Your Computer Request <strong>${number}</strong>was rejected,。</p>
  
  <div style="background-color: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #dc3545; padding: 10px 15px; margin: 15px 0;">
    <p><strong>Reject Reason：</strong></p>
    <p>${reject_reason}</p>
  </div>
  
  <p>Please revise and resubmmit：</p>
  
  <div style="margin: 20px 0; text-align: center;">
    <a href="${resubmit_url}" 
       style="display: inline-block; background-color: #28a745; color: white; 
              padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; 
              font-weight: bold;">
      Click to resubmmit
    </a>
  </div>
  
  <p>or copy the link to your browser：</p>
  <p style="word-break: break-all; color: #007bff;">${resubmit_url}</p>
  
  <p style="margin-top: 30px; color: #6c757d;">Auto mail,please do not reply</p>
</body>
</html>
sysevent_email_template.name: Asset Request Rejected with Resubmit Lin
sysevent_email_template.subject: Your Computer Request ${number} was rejected, please revise and resubmmit,
